process_copy.heading: Mint the ebook NFT
process_copy.body: Buy your ebook NFT for $15 USD. The mint number you receive becomes your referral code.

process_copy.heading: Earn Through Referrals
process_copy.body: Share either your mint number or your link. Whenever someone mints with it, you immediately earn $5 USD with no limit. If no code is provided, the $5 and prize ticket are awarded to a random existing ticket holder.

process_copy.heading: Build Up Tickets
process_copy.body: Every eligible primary mint creates one on-chain ticket. Referral-code mints award it to the referrer, while no-referral mints allocate it to a random existing NFT holder. More tickets mean greater chances to win.

process_copy.heading: Enter the Prize Draw
process_copy.body: One holder of an eligible ticket from each 100-sales block receives $500. Chainlink VRF provides provably fair randomness, and every eligible ticket contributes to the holder's chance of winning.

process_copy.heading: Receive Your Rewards
process_copy.body: Commissions and $500 prize wins are delivered automatically to the winner's wallet, with prize results and notifications available through the Winners page, dashboard, and email when available.

decisions.reason: The ticket-eligibility change does not alter the existing $15 primary-mint allocation among founder, affiliate commission, and Small Block prize pool.
The reported registration discrepancy concerns ticket accounting and leaderboard totals, not the NFT metadata fields or metadata display behavior owned by this Requirement.
The direct-referral commission remains an immediate $5 payment triggered by a referral-code primary mint; randomly allocated no-referral commissions are governed by a separate Requirement.
